faq.answer: A1. The last date to submit online applications for the Research Assistant (Logistics and Supply Chain Management) post at IIM Ahmedabad is 24 August 2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline.

faq.answer: A3. There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIM Ahmedabad Research Assistant Recruitment 2026.
